justification: A is a three-dimensional composition of stacked, hunched anthropomorphic/animal-like heads and limbs in the round, while B is a flat, linear scene dominated by many boats with upturned prows and crew-stroke rows, plus small stick figures and animal signs. The only overlap is the generic presence of highly schematic human-like figures and repeated short strokes; no shared motif, relationship or arrangement supports a common iconographic scheme.
